mapper.insert: INSERT INTO entry_tag (entry_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{entryId}, #{tagId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: INSERT INTO tag (name) VALUES (#{name}) ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name RETURNING id
SELECT t.name FROM tag t JOIN entry_tag et ON et.tag_id = t.id WHERE et.entry_id = #{entryId} ORDER BY t.name
